name: is-standards
title: IS standards metadata from BIS Know Your Standards (no standard texts)

fields.name: is_no
fields.description: IS number and part as this repository names it, e.g. IS 302 (Part 1); the key

fields.name: part
fields.description: Part number, blank when the standard has none

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title as the portal prints it (portal mojibake repaired where detectable)

fields.name: year
fields.description: Year of the latest edition the portal lists

fields.name: status
fields.description: current, withdrawn, superseded or unknown; read from the portal result list, not the details page

fields.name: superseded_by
fields.description: Text after "Superceded by" in the result list

fields.name: supersedes
fields.description: The portal's "Superseding IS" field: the older edition this one replaces

fields.name: amendments
fields.description: JSON list of {number, year, file}; file names only, no download followed

fields.name: qco_status_label
fields.description: The QCO label printed on the details page; the QCO document list itself is gated and not fetched

fields.name: classification
fields.description: JSON object: group, sub group, aspect, certification, ministries, ITC-HS code as printed. No ICS: the public page has none

fields.name: list_flags
fields.description: The result-list row text for the chosen edition, verbatim

fields.name: pk_is_id
fields.description: Portal internal id of the chosen edition; names the archived page raw/is-standards/<date>/<pk>.html

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The BIS details page the record was read from (a POST form; pk_is_id selects the standard)

fields.name: sha256_detail
fields.description: SHA-256 of the details page bytes as received
